title: Clear stale Sync conflicts after successful reconciliation
goal: Keep PASyncEngine.pendingConflicts consistent with the local/remote state after a successful synchronization.
context: When a previously conflicting record later converges or becomes automatically resolvable, synchronize removes its queue item but leaves pendingConflictsMap populated. This can expose stale conflicts to UI callers.
forbidden_changes: Do not silently choose a winner for unresolved divergent records.
Do not clear visible conflict state if queue persistence/removal fails.
Do not weaken lineage verification, conflict resolver, or retry behavior.
Do not modify App/ or Xcode project files.
acceptance_criteria: Every successfully reconciled sync queue item clears any stale conflict entry only after queue removal succeeds.
Unresolved conflicts remain visible and pending.
Regression test creates a conflict, converges local and remote records, synchronizes again, and asserts both conflict state and queue item are cleared.
verification: Confirm Swift package tests + repository integrity, macOS Xcode iOS arm64 build/unsigned IPA, and validate-contract CI gates.
recovery: Revert this single logical commit if conflict visibility is lost on failed queue persistence or existing sync resolution regresses.
